acceptance_criteria.criterion: `api-surface.md` documents all new public interfaces, models, and ViewModel public APIs introduced in M8.
`file-tree.md` lists all 27 new files from the plan's "New files" section in their correct directory positions.
`constraints.md` contains the m041 rollback procedure, the `ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList` rule, and the `ObfuscationService` cancellation contract.
`data-flows.md` includes the Preferences Save flow and the Obfuscation Toggle flow.
`m8-system-tools.md` exists and follows the milestone document template.

summary: WP-015 full M8 manifest update complete. api-surface.md: already contained all M8 public types from prior WP documentation passes; this WP added MysqlDumpBackupService.BuildStartInfo (WP-013 forward) and updated MainContentViewModel constructor (WP-014 forward). constraints.md: added MysqlDumpBackupService ArgumentList rule and ObfuscationService cancellation contract (returns normally, writes flag with CancellationToken.None); m041 rollback was already present. data-flows.md: added section 12 (Preferences Save — AppOptions with{}/SaveAsync/conditional SetAsync) and section 13 (Obfuscation Toggle — full ToggleAsync path with cooperative cancellation). file-tree.md: added MysqlDumpBackupServiceTests.cs, individual M8 model file entries, updated Abstractions/ and Models/ descriptions, added ThumbnailsOptions.cs, added docs/projects/rebuild/milestones/ with m8-system-tools.md. tech-stack.md: already showed revision 41. Created docs/projects/rebuild/milestones/m8-system-tools.md following milestone document template.

comments.note: api-surface.md: All M8 public interfaces (IObfuscationService, IDatabaseBackupService, IDatabaseBackupDialogService), models (MovieForObfuscation, ObfuscationProgress, DatabaseBackupResult, ThumbnailsOptions), and ViewModels (SettingsViewModel, ObfuscationSettingsViewModel, DatabaseBackupViewModel) were already documented by prior WPs. This WP added the MysqlDumpBackupService.BuildStartInfo internal method entry (from WP-013 forward) and updated MainContentViewModel signature (from WP-014 forward).

constraints.md: Added two new rules — (1) MysqlDumpBackupService ArgumentList rule (extending the existing WindowsFileLauncherService entry); (2) ObfuscationService.ToggleAsync cancellation contract (returns normally, never throws OperationCanceledException, writes spdb_config flag with CancellationToken.None). m041 rollback was already present.

data-flows.md: Added section 12 (Preferences Save Flow) covering SaveCommand AppOptions snapshot production, ISettingsService.SaveAsync, conditional IThemeService.SetAsync, and CancelCommand/LoadAsync paths. Added section 13 (Obfuscation Toggle Flow) covering the full ObfuscationService.ToggleAsync path including cooperative cancellation and spdb_config flag write semantics.

file-tree.md: Added MysqlDumpBackupServiceTests.cs to VideoIndexer.Tests/ section; added individual M8 model file entries (MovieForObfuscation.cs, ObfuscationProgress.cs, DatabaseBackupResult.cs); updated Models/ and Abstractions/ directory descriptions to include M8 types; added ThumbnailsOptions.cs under Options/; added docs/projects/rebuild/milestones/ directory with m8-system-tools.md entry.
